input: Checkout errors started five minutes after a payment-api deploy, but the provider status page also shows intermittent 502s. Internal CPU and memory are normal.
notes: Provider evidence is stronger than the deploy distractor.

input: Only the reporting dashboard is stale. The nightly rollup says completed, but downstream tables have yesterday's partition and no retry events were emitted.
notes: Batch output freshness points to a scheduled job path.

input: Login requests are slow across web and mobile after a config refresh. No new code went out; feature flag values changed for auth timeout and issuer URL.
Several pods in inventory keep restarting with image pull errors after one node pool was replaced. Other services in the zone are healthy.
notes: Node pool and image pull symptoms are infrastructure oriented.

input: Cart service latency climbed all morning while connection counts kept rising after each request. Restarting one instance clears it briefly, then the count grows again.
notes: Repeated growth after restart indicates a leak.

input: A viral campaign drove traffic to product pages. Error rate drops when rate limits are enabled even though dependencies remain healthy.
notes: Load is external demand rather than a failed component.

input: Unexpected admin tokens were used from a new ASN, followed by password reset emails and account lockouts. Service health metrics are otherwise normal.
notes: Authentication abuse is the core incident.

input: Order totals are wrong for a subset of invoices after a backfill. The API is fast, but corrected records differ from stored ledger rows.
notes: Persistent incorrect records point to data corruption.

input: Recommendation calls fail only when profile-service returns empty payloads. Retries amplify the failures and then checkout begins timing out too.
notes: An upstream issue spreads into dependent services.

input: A new cart build rolled out to 10 percent of users. Only that version returns null pointer errors when applying coupons.
notes: Failure is isolated to the new release.

input: Payment queue depth is high because the gateway API times out from all regions. Local workers are idle when the provider responds.
notes: Local service waits on an external dependency.

input: Search cluster disk is at 99 percent and writes are rejected. No deployment happened and query traffic is normal.
Checkout fails with 'cert verify failed' after a secret rotation. The payment provider is healthy and old pods still work.
Users see duplicate charges after a replay job. API metrics recovered, but the ledger contains repeated event ids.
notes: Incorrect persisted financial data is the lasting issue.

input: Feed service memory climbs by about 200 MB per hour with stable traffic. Heap snapshots show retained request objects after cache misses.
notes: Unbounded retained objects identify a leak.

input: All customer emails stopped at 02:00. The send service is healthy, but the cron trigger for digest generation never fired.
notes: The scheduled trigger failed before service execution.

input: API errors spike after a schema migration. Only version 2026.08.22 of profile-service writes the new column incorrectly.
notes: Bad behavior is tied to a released service version.

input: EU users cannot upload files. Storage status page reports elevated 5xx in eu-west, while our upload pods are ready.
notes: Regional provider health explains the symptom.

input: A single availability zone lost nodes. Pods rescheduled slowly and ingress targets showed unhealthy for that zone.
Mobile login returns 401 for every request after an auth gateway outage. Other services fail because they cannot validate sessions.
CPU is pinned on image-resizer when a partner imports millions of photos. Scaling the workers reduces errors immediately.
notes: Direct resource saturation resolves with capacity.

input: Public endpoints receive 20x normal traffic from one integration after a product launch. Database and cache are healthy but web workers queue requests.
Multiple support agents report MFA bypass prompts and suspicious OAuth grants. There is no latency or error-rate anomaly.
The pricing endpoint returns old discounts after a manual hotfix. Config store contains a malformed JSON value for active campaign ids.
notes: Malformed config caused the incorrect behavior.

input: New search index build finished successfully, but queries return unrelated products. Rolling back the index restores relevance.
notes: The persisted index contents are wrong.

input: Analytics export says success, yet no file appears in object storage. Logs show the weekly job skipped because the scheduler thought it was a holiday.
Every call to tax-service waits on an upstream vendor. Threads pile up in checkout and cart timeouts follow.
A Kubernetes upgrade changed DNS behavior. Service names intermittently fail to resolve even though app containers did not change.
Checkout code version 412 returns 500 only for gift cards. Version 411 and all other payment methods work.
notes: The defect is isolated to the new version.

input: Notification vendor webhooks are delayed by 40 minutes. Our receiver has spare capacity and queues drain instantly when the vendor catches up.
notes: External vendor delay drives the impact.

input: Cache hit rate drops after normal traffic grows 5x during a sale. Origin database saturates because requests are legitimate but too numerous.
notes: The root is legitimate demand spike.

input: API keys for a dormant integration suddenly create thousands of failed requests from unfamiliar hosts.
Search returns 503 because the JVM heap is full. Restart helps for ten minutes, then retained segment readers grow again.
notes: Resource is exhausted by a leak pattern.

input: The billing database primary is healthy but the disk volume is full. Writes fail with no space left on device.
A feature flag enabled a new ranking algorithm for all tenants by mistake. Disabling the flag restores normal product ordering.
The import worker deployed at noon and immediately began dropping rows with unicode names. Previous worker version imports the same file correctly.
notes: New code version introduced parser behavior.

input: Fraud checks timeout because the scoring service depends on a slow feature store. Checkout retry storms then overload payment-service.
Dashboard says inventory is negative for several SKUs. The API now works, but an earlier consumer wrote decrements twice.
notes: Bad stored state remains after service recovery.

input: Daily compliance report did not arrive. The pipeline sensor waited forever on an upstream marker file that was never created.
notes: Scheduled pipeline dependency did not complete.

input: Object storage in ap-south returns elevated 503. Upload retries fail from every app instance only in that region.
New nodes join the cluster but cannot pull base images due to registry auth on the node role. Workloads stay pending.
A competitor mention sends 30x traffic to signup. Rate limiting anonymous users stabilizes all services.
notes: Traffic surge is the root pressure.

input: Support sees password reset floods and impossible-travel logins. The checkout slowdown is only from extra auth challenges.
notes: Operational symptoms are secondary to account attack.

input: Connection pool usage grows after each failed query and never returns to baseline. Recycling app pods restores service temporarily.
The queue has 9 million messages and consumers are at max CPU. Adding consumers reduces lag, no code changes involved.
The content service started returning 403 after a policy document was edited. Reverting the IAM policy fixes it.
A data cleanup task removed active subscription rows. Restoring from backup fixes access for affected customers.
notes: Incorrect stored records caused user impact.

input: ML scoring deploy increased latency for one endpoint only. Canary users hit timeouts; stable users are unaffected.
notes: Canary scope points to deployment regression.

input: The message broker lost quorum after two hosts rebooted during maintenance. Producers time out across several apps.
Shipping quotes fail because carrier-api returns malformed JSON. Our parser works against captured valid responses.
notes: Upstream payload changed outside our system.

input: Email open tracking shows gaps. The hourly aggregation job was disabled during testing and never re-enabled.
One service emits thousands of retries after config points it to the staging endpoint. Downstream staging cannot handle production load.
notes: Wrong endpoint is a configuration error.

input: Recommendation cache entries grow without expiry. Memory alarms fire after several hours and cache restart clears them.
notes: Unbounded retained cache entries are leak-like.

input: A bulk upload from a new enterprise customer saturates file processors. Throttling that tenant restores normal latency.
The account deletion endpoint was exploited using forged requests. Logs show valid signatures missing but requests still accepted.
After an ETL run, customer tiers are shifted by one row. Services are healthy but entitlements are wrong.
notes: Bad data transformation corrupts entitlement state.

input: All calls to address verification time out. The vendor reports maintenance, and disabling verification lets checkout continue.
A cache cluster hits max clients. App servers are fine, but every request waits on cache connection acquisition.
Search autocomplete fails after a library upgrade. Rolling back the package restores suggestions immediately.
Profile-service outage causes feed, notifications, and checkout personalization to fail. Feed errors continue due to aggressive retries.
The daily settlement job ran twice after daylight saving transition. Merchants see duplicate payouts.
The CDN returns 502 for static assets globally while origin health checks pass. Provider incident says edge routing degraded.
New firewall rules block health checks to internal load balancers. No application code changed.
Unexpected card testing traffic pounds payment forms. Legitimate traffic is normal, but abusive attempts consume worker slots.
notes: Abuse/security event is the root despite traffic pressure.

input: Checkout latency improves only when the external fraud score call is skipped. Fraud service logs show request backlog.
A typo in the Redis hostname was pushed through config management. Services fail to connect until the value is corrected.
The export job produced a file with missing columns. It ran on schedule, but the transformation query joined the wrong table.
Workers show file descriptor counts rising with every websocket disconnect. Restarting clears fd usage temporarily.
CPU and queue wait spike when a celebrity links to a public report. Disabling anonymous report generation stabilizes service.
notes: Demand surge overloads a heavy endpoint.

input: A rollout changed retry defaults from 2 to 20. Provider blips now trigger massive retry storms.
The fraud provider is healthy, but our fraud-client library cannot parse its new enum after deploy.
The fraud provider changed response fields without notice and all clients reject the payload. No internal deploy occurred.
notes: External contract changed without internal release.

input: A stale DNS record sends 30 percent of traffic to decommissioned instances. Updating the record fixes the split failures.
Billing reads fail because the database replica is 45 minutes behind. Primary writes are healthy; read traffic uses stale replica.
Account balances are off by cents after a currency conversion deploy. Recomputing from source events fixes the ledger.
notes: Persisted derived financial state is wrong.

input: A recommender outage causes homepage, search, and emails to fail because callers treat recommendations as mandatory.
notes: One service failure cascades through callers.

input: The fraud scoring job did not publish the morning model. Online scoring serves yesterday's model and misses new rules.
The secrets manager throttles all reads. New pods cannot start, but existing pods keep serving until restarted.
notes: Startup depends on an unavailable dependency.

input: The log pipeline consumes all ephemeral disk on API nodes. App errors disappear after log buffers are drained.
notes: Node disk capacity exhausted by logs.

input: Admin page loads slowly because each request opens a database connection and never closes it.
A scripted signup attack creates millions of fake accounts. Database write load is high, but the source is abusive automation.
One customer import uses a 9 GB CSV and all workers spend minutes parsing it. Normal imports are fine when the large job is paused.
Mobile app cannot fetch feature flags because the flag service returns 503. App backend is healthy but waits for flags.
notes: A dependency outage blocks the caller.

input: Terraform applied the wrong subnet route table. Internal API calls work in one subnet and fail in another.
A template deploy escapes HTML incorrectly in password reset emails. Only the new template version is broken.
Config rollout sets max cart items to zero for enterprise tenants. Reverting the config restores checkout.
A replay consumer processed old refund events against current orders. Customer credits are now inconsistent.
Nightly thumbnail generation is four hours late. Worker pool is idle because the orchestrator never queued tasks.
A provider webhook signs events with a rotated key. Our service rejects every event until provider publishes the new certificate.
A dependency timeout in catalog makes cart fallback to stale prices, then checkout refuses price mismatch.
Memory is fine, CPU is fine, but every worker waits for a limited license token from a third-party OCR system.
A single malformed config value sets sampling to 100 percent and overloads the tracing collector.
The autoscaler cannot add nodes because the cloud quota is exhausted. Pending pods accumulate during normal traffic.
A seasonal sale doubles normal checkout volume. All components are healthy individually, but request queues exceed SLA.
A model deploy changed the fraud threshold and blocks normal users. Rolling back the model package restores approvals.
Deleted product images still appear for some users because CDN invalidation job failed overnight.
notes: Scheduled invalidation job did not run.

input: User profile records contain names from other accounts after a bad bulk merge. APIs return quickly but privacy data is wrong.
Long-lived websocket sessions remain registered after disconnect. Presence counts grow until the service runs out of memory.
An attacker enumerates coupon codes and triggers fraud rules. Checkout errors are concentrated on suspicious IP ranges.
The analytics vendor API returns 429 to every export job. Backoff helps but reports remain delayed until vendor quota resets.
notes: External provider rate limit blocks exports.
